# Board or strategic meeting — meeting archetype

## When this lens applies

Apply this lens to high-level financial, partnership, hiring, portfolio, or
strategic decisions. Treat the segment as sensitive.

## What to extract

Capture decisions and rationale, strategic updates, actions, owners, and open
items for the next session. Keep restricted material out of broad destinations.

## Missing topics worth noting

Note strategic actions without owners or decisions without an explicit next
review point when that omission matters.

## Common interpretation mistakes

Do not expose sensitive detail, infer consensus from silence, or turn directional
discussion into an operational commitment.
